prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a portrait 1024x1536 full-bleed illustrated BACKGROUND for a fantasy island app called Pokomoko; no text, letters, UI, border, watermark, people, mascots or faces. The user rejects tiny busy polka dots and also rejects large pastel nursery wallpaper as too cute. They want WONDER, a mysterious dreamlike FANTASY, while retaining strong large polka dots and an inviting, tactile quality. Art direction: sophisticated surreal picture-book art, rich opaque color shapes, convincing layered space, soft matte surfaces, clear large forms rather than tiny decoration. Balance cobalt/ultramarine and jade/teal with restrained ivory and warm coral or ochre. Mysterious yet friendly, daylight or luminous twilight, never a scary black cave. Dots must belong to impossible surfaces and space, not confetti floating uniformly on a flat white page. Avoid pastel baby decor, smiling mushrooms, generic sparkles, stars, moons, glitter, lens flare, photorealism, text. COMPOSITION FOR REAL UI: the upper-middle 65% will be overlaid by four ivory settings cards. Concentrate the large striking forms and beautiful spatial details along the side margins and in the bottom 35%, with a quieter midtone upper center. Do not place the only interesting object in the center behind the cards. Maintain a readable, intriguing portrait crop. DIRECTION A: An impossible blue dream-space of sweeping rounded hills and fabric-like curved planes folding gently away into a luminous turquoise distance. Two or three large curved forms at the bottom and sides carry boldly contrasting irregular IVORY polka dots that change scale with perspective. A few warm ochre dots, subtle broad shadows, depth and a distant open passage. Show an inviting abstract fantasy landscape to enter, not a vortex, tunnel, repeating pattern tile, psychedelic optical noise, or ocean foam. Lower foreground cobalt, middle jade/teal, spacious light turquoise distance. Strong spatial wonder, almost like walking into a polka-dot dream.
